results.title: Seaweed Snacks
results.overview: A hard-edged dad just wants to survive another birthday party, but when a try-hard super dad won’t take “no” for an answer, things get real awkward…real fast.

results.title: The Man with the Big Hat
results.original_title: The Man with the Big Hat
results.overview: An unsung pioneer of 1970s Texas Progressive Country, Steven Fromholz had a knack for snatching defeat from the jaws of victory. Revered by legends like Willie Nelson, Lyle Lovett & John Denver, he remained commercially unknown. He sought redemption on the Rio Grande as a river guide until a debilitating stroke erased his musical memory, stripping Fromholz of his artistic identity.  With an almost obsessive persistence bolstered by newly discovered archives as well as never-before-heard recordings, this intimate and impressionistic portrayal unveils the evolution of Fromholz, and reshapes the notion of success and artistic fortitude.

results.title: Zakir Khan: Papa Yaar
results.overview: Zakir Khan reflects on his childhood and the special bond he shares with his father, turning personal memories and family experiences into heartfelt comedy. With his signature blend of observational humour, poetry and emotional storytelling, he explores the unspoken sides of fatherhood and the relationship between a father and son.

results.title: Yo (Love Is a Rebellious Bird)
results.overview: After losing her friend Yo, Anna builds a detailed 1/3-scale version of her friend's house. It is just big enough for Anna to squeeze into, and inside lives a puppet of Yo. When the pair first met, Yo was 73 and Anna 24.

results.title: Bloodthirsty
results.overview: On the night of their anniversary, Sarah is unexpectedly called into work but when a sudden zombie outbreak traps her inside, Brian must fight through the chaos to reach her before it's too late.

results.title: Small Hours
results.overview: Struggling with alcohol addiction and mental illness, an artist reaches out to an old friend.

results.title: Zebras
results.overview: Two detectives, one is an old school grizzled veteran and the other an ambitious rookie. Both from different races, genders, generations and backgrounds are paired up on a dangerous stakeout. Opposing realities clash only to be forced to work side by side against the very forces of evil.

results.title: England 'Til I Die
results.overview: Filmed as events unfold, an anonymous protester is transformed into a prominent figure in Britain's growing anti-immigration movement.

results.title: Barangay Love Stories: Infatuated
results.overview: At first glance, there seems to be no room for love between Leo, a cold and aloof boss, and Aya, his secretary who secretly has feelings for him. But what happens when Leo gradually falls for Aya? Will the way he treats her change when he discovers her true feelings for him?

results.title: The School Photographer
results.overview: With the film industry in decline, Björn (50), a seasoned first assistant director, finds himself unemployed and adrift. To stay afloat, he takes a temporary job as a school photographer—an unfamiliar and humbling role. Over the course of one long day, Björn's fragile calm is tested by a string of phone calls from his mother, his teenage daughter, and his ex-wife. Each conversation pulls him further off balance, and the tension begins to seep into the portraits he takes. As his professional facade starts to crack, an unexpected encounter with a P.E. teacher at the school offers a brief moment of understanding—and a hint that change might still be possible.

results.title: Cashcade
results.overview: A burglar on the run accidentally leaves a trail of cash that leads a homeless man into an unexpected discovery.

results.title: Phera
results.overview: Two men share a house and a past that no longer fits them. As city life pulls Palash forward and age holds his father Pannalal in place, an unexpected return forces them to confront their differences and the quiet truths they have avoided.

results.title: High Steaks

results.title: Time of Cinema
